title: 浅水溃坝 Ritter/Stoker 精确解验证（算例池）
summary: 浅水方程（SWE）溃坝黎曼问题对 Ritter (1892) 干床与 Stoker (1957) 湿床闭式解的验证。波前位置 x_f(t)、静水区水位阶跃 h2/h1、整条深度剖面 L1 与波形单调性（无伪振荡）在 t*=2 对闭式解逐项判定，容差 <5%。
external_anchor: Ritter (1892) Z. Ver. Deutsch. Ing. 36:947-954（干床稀疏波，波前 x_f = 2t√(gh0)）；Stoker (1957) Water Waves, ch.10（湿床稀疏波+恒定态+水跃，水跃速度 U 由 Riemann 不变量确定）

front_fan.statement: Ritter 干床波前位置（fan 估计器，继承闭式形状）相对误差

shock_position.statement: Stoker 湿床水跃位置（亚网格深度交叉）相对误差

step_ratio.statement: 静水区水位阶跃 h2/h1（平台深度均值/下游深度均值）相对误差

depth_l1.statement: 整条深度剖面相对 L1 误差

front_series.statement: 整条 x_f(t) 序列最大相对误差（分级样本，SERIES_MIN_CELLS=4）

monotone.statement: 波形单调无伪振荡：内部局部极值数（振幅 >1e-4 h0）

gate_criteria.statement: Ritter 干床波前位置 front_fan 相对误差 <5%
Stoker 湿床水跃位置 shock_position 相对误差 <5%
静水区水位阶跃 h2/h1 相对误差 <5%
整条深度剖面相对 L1 误差 <5%
整条 x_f(t) 序列最大相对误差 <5%（分级样本）
波形单调无伪振荡：内部局部极值数 = 0

verdict_qualified: PASS at n>=800 in both the Ritter dry bed and the Stoker wet bed: accepted_n = 800 in docs/case-fvm-dambreak-stoker/artifacts/reproduction.json, the probe ladder this qualification rests on (re-derived into probe_ladder). At n=200 the fan_head probe misses the 5% gate on both beds (Ritter 5.584%, Stoker 10.541%) and for Stoker still at n=400 (5.779%) — the coarse grid does not resolve the rarefaction head; this is recorded honestly, not hidden. The n=1600 headline six (front_fan, shock_position, step_ratio, depth_l1, front_series, monotone) all pass the 5% gate, but their margins span gate_margins.headline_weakest: the weakest is 5.92x (stoker-wet front_series) and ritter-dry depth_l1 is 64.81x, so an earlier version of this sentence that claimed a three-digit margin for the same six keys was overstated and is retracted here; no artifact number changes with the retraction.
acceptance_criterion: 波前位置 x_f(t) 与静水区水位阶跃 vs 解析（t*=2，波形须单调无伪振荡），容差 <5%
notes: 几何为 1-D 平底（无船体几何，故不适用 Cb/L/B 前置校验）。L∞ 深度误差只报告不判定（捕捉间断必然带 O(dx) 误差）。front_wetted（湿润边缘）为深度地板探测器，不收敛，仅作 legacy 诊断报告。
graded_set_note: Closure audit (docs/audit-dambreak-anchor-closure/AUDIT.md): the registered aggregate all_pass = all(_verdict[...]['pass']) is the intersection of MORE keys than the headline six listed in verdict_qualified. Per case the graded set is: ritter-dry = front_fan, front_wetted, depth_l1, monotone, tv_no_growth, front_series (6); stoker-wet = shock_position, step_ratio, plateau_h2, depth_l1, monotone, tv_no_growth, bore_position_modes, step_ratio_modes, front_series (9); every value, limit and margin of these keys is re-derived into gate_margins. Among these, front_wetted<5% is graded but the same artifact bundle publishes the quantity as 'front_wetted_diagnostic' with a NON-CONVERGENT ladder (8.75%, 1.88%, 1.56%, 2.66%, 2.89% at n=100..1600) and this entry's own notes call it a diagnostic. Margin reading, corrected 2026-11-16 by re-derivation: front_wetted<5% is the only graded key with a margin below 2x, but it is not the only one below 12x — gate_margins.under_12x lists all 4 keys (front_wetted<5% 1.73x, stoker-wet tv_no_growth<0.5% 4.98x, stoker-wet front_series<5% 5.92x, ritter-dry front_series<5% 11.77x). Earlier wordings that called front_wetted<5% the sole graded key under a double-digit margin bound, and that put the acceptance elements' weakest margin at the front_series level of the dry bed only, were overstated and are retracted; the four margins above replace them. The acceptance sentence's three elements have a weakest finite margin of 4.98x (stoker-wet tv_no_growth<0.5%, whose own limit is 0.5%), or 5.92x counting only the 5% gates (stoker-wet front_series<5%). No artifact number is changed by this note; demoting the front_wetted reading to diagnostic-only is a behaviour change left to a separate review.

gate_margins.definition: margin = limit / value at the pool grid; a zero-valued error has an unbounded margin (null + margin_infinite)
